anger.line: 'Til we come into town in a stark ravin' anger
stanza: How many boys could they haul off this mountain
Shoot full of holes, cuffed and layin' in the streets
'Til we come into town in a stark ravin' anger
Looking for answers and armed to the teeth?

anger.songTitle: In the Heat of the Summer
anger.line: And the shame was replacing the anger
stanza: And when the fury was over
And the shame was replacing the anger
So wrong, so wrong, but we've been down too long
And we had to make somebody listen
In the heat of the summer
There are people in your life
You know they hurt your pride
You better put it all behind you, baby
It'll eat you up inside, baby

anger.line: Put one in the chamber whenever I'm feelin' this anger
anger.linePrev: I'm headed for danger, don't trust strangers
anger.lineNext: Don't wanna make excuses 'cause this is how it is, what's the use?
